verdict.rationale: The evidence covers agent-initiated payments, tokenization, ACP/UCP checkout flows and feed sync to AI platforms. None of it documents attributing orders to the originating agent, or reporting on or filtering transactions by agent. Per-platform integrations, such as the Google agents flow, are adjacent and do not show agent attribution in merchant reporting.

support.subject: As a merchant, orders are attributed to the originating agent and I can report on or filter transactions by agent
